description: BAe Hawk jet trainer mounted on a plinth at the centre of a landscaped roundabout on the internal road network of the Khalifa bin Zayed Air College at Al Ain International Airport. Clearly resolvable as a jet on the plinth in Esri World Imagery acquired 21 September 2025. No serial has been reported.

MB-326KD gate guard about 800 m east of the Hawk on the Khalifa bin Zayed Air College road network. A spottingmode contributor states the airframe here is either serial 201 or serial 208, so no serial is entered. An aircraft-shaped object is present at the position in Esri imagery of 21 September 2025.
